findings.consequence: Time/RSS/output monitoring can cease while the owned CPU stage remains live.
findings.defect: There is no exception-safe cleanup around the Popen child. I/O failures or KeyboardInterrupt after spawning bypass the normal failure/signal/reap branch; the outer handler writes a failure and raises without terminating or reaping the new-session child.
findings.repair: Preserve the original exception and always perform safe owned-child termination and authoritative wait4 cleanup; receipt-write failures must not skip cleanup.
findings.title: Live child can be abandoned when monitoring raises

findings.consequence: A later wait4 can raise ChildProcessError and lose authoritative terminal resource usage.
findings.defect: Normal POSIX CPython Popen signaling polls and may reap an exited child. If exit occurs between the explicit wait4 probe and terminate/kill, Popen may consume the terminal while the supervisor local code/usage remain unset.
findings.evidence_kind: Static race path and standard POSIX CPython Popen behavior; no runtime or race test.
findings.repair: Keep one authoritative reaper and use signaling without internal polling/reaping, handling exit/signaling races while preserving the direct-child wait relationship.
findings.title: Popen terminate/kill can reap before authoritative wait4

findings.consequence: An unlisted json.py or tarfile.py can enter the child import directory and execute before available_custody.authorize, even while every fixed source-manifest hash still matches.
findings.defect: The client checks listed packet members but stages all regular files, does not pin the packet manifest it uses, and does not reject extra/symlink files in the staging loop. The remote accepts arbitrary source/ files and authenticates only the declared executable members.
findings.evidence_kind: Static import/staging counterexample; no file created, imported or tested.
findings.repair: Stage and remotely enforce an exact authenticated inventory, bind any used packet manifest to its immutable pin, and reject extras and symlinks.
findings.title: Extra source files bypass executable inventory closure

findings.consequence: An inspection finishing between 600 and 900 seconds can be accepted despite its declared bound.
findings.defect: The recipe and authorizer freeze a 600-second soft limit, but inspector main has no timer or soft-limit check. The supervisor only imposes the 900-second stage bound.
findings.evidence_kind: Static missing bound use and normal completion path; no timing test.
findings.repair: Enforce the frozen soft elapsed limit through receipt production or explicitly revise the reviewed contract before release; retain complete semantic/population checks.
findings.title: Inspector ignores its frozen 600-second soft bound
